=== Enter at the end of an item adds a sibling below it
--- given
- a‸
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
- ‸

=== Enter in the middle of a line moves the tail to the new item
--- given
- ab‸cd
--- when key Enter
--- then
- ab
- ‸cd

=== Enter at the end of an item with children makes the new item the first child
--- given
- a‸
  - b
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
  - ‸
  - b

=== Enter mid-line on an item with children hands the children to the new item
--- given
- a‸b
  - c
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
- ‸b
  - c

=== Enter at the end of a folded item adds a sibling after the folded subtree
--- given
- a‸ ⊟
  - b
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a ⊟
  - b
- ‸

=== Enter mid-line on a folded item keeps the children folded under the head
--- given
- a‸b ⊟
  - c
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a ⊟
  - c
- ‸b

=== Enter carries a task box over, unchecked
--- given
- [x] a‸
--- when key Enter
--- then
- [x] a
- [ ] ‸

=== Enter carries a task box onto a new first child
--- given
- [ ] a‸
  - [ ] b
--- when key Enter
--- then
- [ ] a
  - [ ] ‸
  - [ ] b

=== Enter renumbers an ordered list
--- given
1. a‸
2. b
--- when key Enter
--- then
1. a
2. ‸
3. b

=== Enter makes a numbered first child and renumbers the old one
--- given
1. a‸
   1. b
--- when key Enter
--- then
1. a
   1. ‸
   2. b

=== Enter on an empty nested item outdents it
--- given
- a
  - ‸
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
- ‸

=== Enter on an empty nested item at the third level outdents one level
--- given
- a
  - b
    - ‸
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
  - b
  - ‸

=== Enter on the only item, empty, passes to the editor
--- given
- ‸
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- ‸

=== Enter on an empty top-level item among others passes to the editor
--- given
- a
- ‸
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
- ‸

=== Enter with the cursor inside the bullet passes to the editor
--- given stick=never
-‸ a
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
-‸ a

=== Enter with a selection passes to the editor
--- given
- ⟨a⟩b
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- ⟨a⟩b

=== Enter inside a fenced code block passes to the editor
--- given
- a
  ```
  code‸
  ```
--- nodes 2 HyperMD-codeblock_HyperMD-codeblock-bg
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a
  ```
  code‸
  ```

=== Enter on a notes line splits it and moves the later notes along
--- given
- a
  no‸te
  more
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
  no
- ‸te
  more

=== Enter at the end of the last notes line adds a sibling
--- given
- a
  note‸
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
  note
- ‸

=== Enter at the end of the bullet line moves the notes to the new item
--- given
- a‸
  note
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
- ‸
  note

=== Enter passes to the editor when the Enter behaviour is switched off
--- given enter=off
- a‸
  - b
--- when key Enter
--- then passthrough
- a‸
  - b

=== Enter keeps the sibling's bullet style
--- given
* a‸
--- when key Enter
--- then
* a
* ‸

=== Enter at the end of a tab-indented child adds a sibling with the same indent
--- given unit=tab
- a
	- b‸
--- when key Enter
--- then
- a
	- b
	- ‸
